actual_authoring_policy.important_distinction: Ten percent of assignments receive evaluation-origin authoring focus. For anchors without a mapped related generator, the normal generator ID remains selected and the assignment is an inspired extension; this is still focus, not a lost draw.

alternative_allocation_estimate.estimate_status: proposal inferred from three current records and retained receipts; no causal gain measured
alternative_allocation_estimate.expected_quality_per_cost_tradeoff: Compared with concentrating almost all generator IDs in the approved-original parameter tier, the shadow pilot spends 30% on closing repair/prototype evidence debt. Expected routine throughput is lower, but the retained output should contain a higher fraction of accepted settings with four distinct Racket-labelled queries, because ambiguous or inert contracts are measured before repeated export. This is an estimate, not a measured improvement.
alternative_allocation_estimate.kind: 30-assignment shadow authoring pilot; no production policy or training-mixture change
metrics: episodes with three identifying demonstrations and four distinct Racket-labelled queries
alternative_allocation_estimate.stopping_rule: Run at most 30 assignments and at least three in each non-evaluation stratum. Stop expanding a stratum if fewer than half are routine-complete, or if its median reviewer minutes exceed twice the approved-parameter stratum without at least a 20% gain in accepted unique four-query episodes per 100 Racket executions. Stop immediately on a source/rule label mismatch, hidden-answer/public-ID leakage, or unapproved training admission.

catalog_population.assessment: Catalog approval gates default dataset export, so equal positive mix_weight does not admit unapproved rows. Among admitted rows, however, unit weights do not encode lesson evidence, unresolved audits, four-query support, Racket cost, or deduplication yield.

coverage_limit: The deterministic sample contains two training/augmented originals and one bank source; it contains no ARC-GEN or RE-ARC record. It cannot estimate source-wide defect rates, compare external libraries, or infer model loss. Only current packet identities and retained evidence were inspected.

287285d0145f.assessment: The source is hash-fresh but train_safety is unverified, so it is outside both main and normal authoring pools. It declares ten axes, while palette_kind, palette_size, position_bias, n_distinct_colors, and density do not affect normal returned pixels; helpful texture aliases are inert, and two advertised degenerate textures intentionally violate self_check. No focused tests, review index, lesson schedule, semantic rivals, or four-query evidence are retained. The unit mix weight is not admission or quality evidence.
287285d0145f.classification: unapproved bank coverage source with cheap geometry but weak contract evidence
287285d0145f.cost_observation: Estimated low raw Racket cost from sparse 6–10-side grids, but likely high repair/rejection and deduplication risk; no measured accepted-episode yield exists.

42f19ef6d600.assessment: One observable scene_profile axis covers four public plus twelve generalized profiles, and retained tests exercise broad geometry. However the current source declares no EXAMPLES_NEEDED, lesson period, semantic rivals, or witness map. A current-source audit records that three easy demonstrations fit an always-solid-side-strips rival while a blocked-marks query differs; it also records a missing semantic contract and a nonportable test preflight. Four-query supervision is therefore unverified despite catalog approval and unit mix weight.
42f19ef6d600.classification: approved original with broad scene grammar but unresolved teaching support
42f19ef6d600.cost_observation: Estimated medium generation cost, but unresolved lesson ambiguity can waste downstream Racket, deduplication, and training compute; no measured per-episode cost is available.

d3575d4206d7.assessment: The current source exposes four axes, EXAMPLES_NEEDED=3, a four-step schedule, thirteen semantic rivals, eight witness groups, and an executable lesson_identifiable contract. Current notes retain 39 focused tests, a 12-stage battery, 20,520 override draws, 600 morphology draws, and 300 lessons with 1,200 distinct query holdouts and no declared-rival ambiguity. The index still carries a needs-evidence audit row from the older 3.0.0 source, so triage provenance remains a review cost rather than proof of a current defect.
d3575d4206d7.classification: approved repaired original with explicit three-demo/four-holdout curriculum and high retained evidence cost
d3575d4206d7.cost_observation: High measured review/Racket evidence volume and 17–27-side grids, but it yields source-bound four-query supervision and 1,200 distinct inputs; quality-per-label is stronger than provenance or weight alone suggests.
